syllabus_topics: Showing methods to analyze and resolve crisis situations
Examining the relationships between crisis planning, crisis team, and ethical decision-making and implementation processes
Understanding personal response situations according to knowledge, ability, talent, and resources
Developing analysis skills to minimize chaos and damages during pre-crisis, crisis, and post-crisis situations
Synthesizing crisis prediction, crisis preparation, rapid response, follow-up, and post-crisis evaluation processes
Applying processes for criterion selection, training, and crisis team formation
Researching, creating, and writing a crisis management guide
